canonical.title: Weekend in Da Nang: La Maison 1888 & Beyond

siblings.title: Things to do in and around Da Nang
siblings.summary: Field-guide to a weekend in Da Nang: Son Tra peninsula, Hoi An lanterns, Ba Na/Golden Bridge, Hai Van Pass, Michelin food map, and the Dragon Bridge fire show.

siblings.title: Dinner at La Maison 1888, Da Nang
siblings.summary: Central Vietnam's only Michelin-starred restaurant: French haute cuisine in a Bill Bensley colonial mansion at the InterContinental Sun Peninsula resort.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events in Da Nang
siblings.summary: Da Nang's tech calendar spans April's flagship DevDay, Web3, academic AI/ML conferences and monthly GDG meetups.
